releaseNotes:
What changed:
- On a phone, the bottom bar now stays put on a film's page and on an actor or crew
  member's page, so another section is one press away instead of needing Back first.
- The button that clears a search has moved down beside the search box, at the end of
  the line it belongs to, rather than sitting in the far top corner of the screen.

Already on 1.53.0 or newer? This installs itself as usual.

On 1.52.1 or older? 1.53.0 changed the app's identity, so Android will not install this
over your copy and the in-app update stops with "The downloaded update belongs to a
different app." Uninstall GIZTV once, then install this build from the release page.
Watch history does not carry across that one reinstall. Updates after it are automatic.
